nom: Cetaphil Hydrating & Firming Skin Activator Neck and Chest Cream

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some sensitive to fragrance, report no irritation from this fragrance-free cream, though one reviewer had a severe allergic reaction and could not continue using it.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the cream slightly increased her oiliness, though it caused no irritation on her sensitive areas.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s, and beyond describe using the cream to address crepey, thinning, or sagging skin on the neck and chest, with several reporting firmer, smoother skin after weeks of use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother, firmer, less crepey-looking skin on the neck and chest after consistent use over one to several weeks, though a few say the firming effect is short-lived, subtle, or not noticeably different from before-and-after photos.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, describe the cream as strongly hydrating with lasting moisture; one notes it keeps skin hydrated for about 48 hours.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers using the cream alongside retinoids or tretinoin report it soothes irritation and helps reinforce the skin barrier.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, report no breakouts or clogged pores from this cream, even when used on the face.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin found the cream slightly increased her oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Thick, rich texture that some find too heavy for the face
Absorbs quickly without a greasy residue
Fragrance-free, suits those sensitive to scent
Feels tacky or sticky while drying
Firming results seen as subtle or slow to appear

extraits.texte: This lotion feels great going on — it absorbs quickly, isn't greasy, and you can see and feel a difference almost right away. My skin looks smoother and more hydrated immediately after applying, which is nice. The downside is that the effect doesn't last very long; within a few hours, the "firmed" look fades and the crepey texture shows again. Good for a quick boost, but not a long-term solution. I received this item for free in exchange for my honest review.

extraits.titre: good cream, didn't notice a difference in texture
extraits.texte: I use this a good bit on my neck and face for the last month or so. I personally did not experience a significant change in my skin appearance or texture during this time. It was a nice lotion and I enjoyed using it, but again it was nothing special for me and how it fixed appearance or texture problems. I will enjoy continuing to use it as I finish up the product, but I wouldn't buy again since it is specifically supposed to fix creepiness and firmness problems in the skin.

I was thrilled when I saw that Cetaphil had developed a line for aging skin! I've trusted Cetaphil for years to provide gentle, yet effective care to my skin. I was lucky enough to try three products in this line: the Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Lotion, Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Cream, and Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Neck, Chest, and Face Cream. Like all Cetaphil products, these are fragrance-free and non-irritating. I've tried all of them and the star of the show, in my humble opinion, is the Neck, Chest, and Face Cream. I'm 45 years old and my chest and neck are starting to get a slight crepey appearance (I would love to tell my younger self to stay out of the sun!). This cream absorbed immediately and I could see a difference within 2 days. It plumped my skin nicely and my skin felt soft and hydrated. The appearance of crepiness was definitely diminished. (I only used this product on my neck and chest as I have another more targeted product that I prefer for my face, which is not experiencing as much crepiness yet.) The other two products, the Skin Activator Hydrating and Firming Lotion and Hydrating & Firming Cream, are fantastic as well. Since we are at the end of summer here in the Midwest, and it's sweltering during the day, I started with the lotion. It's a perfect weight for daytime use and again delivered quick visible results. extraits.titre: Great nighttime cream for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin and am sensitive to fragrance, so I love that this didn't irritate my skin and is fragrance-free. The tube makes it easy to get the right amount out without any waste like a pump. This absorbed fully into my skin without feeling heavy. Keep in mind some makeup products might pill on top of this, depending on the base; make sure the makeup base is the same as this cream for best results if wearing makeup. This does not have any sun protection, so I prefer to apply this as my PM moisturizer. I don't have crepey skin but could use some firming; I didn't notice any changes in the texture of my skin, but maybe I needed to use it longer to see results.

extraits.titre: The Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Ne
extraits.texte: The Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Neck, Chest & Face Cream has quickly become one of my favorites! The texture is silky and nourishing but still feels lightweight, so it glides on beautifully and absorbs without leaving any residue. I especially love using it on my neck and chest, areas that often get overlooked but really show signs of aging. One thing that makes this cream extra special for me is how well it pairs with my tretinoin routine. After using tret, my skin can feel a bit irritated and fragile, and this cream soothes instantly while reinforcing my barrier. The CICA calms my skin, and the hydration lasts for hours, leaving me with a plump, comfortable glow. Over time, I've noticed my skin looking smoother and firmer, and the fact that it's fragrance-free and gentle makes me trust it even more. It's like a skin comfort blanket that also works hard behind the scenes to keep my skin healthy, firm, and radiant.

extraits.titre: Great lotion for your aging skin.
extraits.texte: By far, this is my favorite facial lotion. It's thick and creamy, and it has made a noticeable difference in my skin. I've seen my face become firmer, the bags under my eyes diminish, and my crow's feet soften. I do have oily skin, and this lotion has increased that oiliness slightly. However, even with my sensitive skin, I was able to use it on my neck and around my ears without any irritation. A big plus, it has no perfumes scent and the tube package is great for traveling.
